{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''High Hand''''' was a passenger barge that was owned by the [[Oblee]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nirama]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In c. [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Nirama opened up the [[Cularin asteroid belt]] for exploration, sparking the [[Confederation Rock Rush]], and he traveled to the [[Asteroid field/Legends|belt]] in the ''High Hand''. He summoned the [[Heroes of Cularin]] to meet with him aboard the ''Hand'' and after they had arrived, he hired them to investigate a set of co-ordinates located within the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] belt, assigning the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Teeloo]] to assist them.
